'''Gargath''' was an enormous [[Kintan crusher]] who roamed [[Gargath's Watch]], an area of the [[Clabburn Tundra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The crusher was attacked by a group of offworlders and [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
